summary_role: Implementation-side descriptive summary; independent review must recompute raw records
limits: Headless installed browser on loopback; not visible acceptance or real phone/network
Cold means browser HTTP cache only; OS, process and code caches are not claimed cold
Readiness includes identical external observer cost and two stable animation frames
Long tasks include observer and browser work and are not assigned to a package
Resource Timing transferSize is browser-reported transfer; does not measure TCP/IP packet overhead
Largest observed body per full URL; every request remains in transfer sums
Warm is reload in same page/context after verified cold entry; actual cache outcome remains observed
FCP and navigation timing describe document loads; SPA navigation uses browser click-to-ready timing
